answer.rationale: Write-path p99 climbing for 90 min starting shortly after a release 2h ago points to the release as the most likely cause; memory_b1 supports rollback as a fast, customer-safe recovery. Peak settlement traffic is a confounder, so memory_b3 (capacity headroom) is worth verifying to rule out a pure load problem — but adding capacity is slower and does not address a regression, and the write path is not helped by read replicas (b5) or circuit breakers (b4, dependency-scoped). Rollback preserves in-flight writes if the prior build is schema-compatible; I would confirm no breaking data migration shipped before executing. If verification of b3 shows the release coincided with a known traffic-driven saturation pattern, I would reconsider add_capacity.
